from pathlib import Path
from nisayon.evaluation.decision import evaluate_bundle
from nisayon.engine.io import write_json
records=[]
for case,expected in [('D01-gripper-sign','accepted'),('D05-recurrent-carry','rejected')]:
 root=Path('artifacts/development-ablation-001')/case/'A/confirmation/execution'
 result=evaluate_bundle(root/'bundle.json',artifact_root=root)
 assert result['decision']==expected, (case,result['decision'])
 write_json(Path('artifacts/engine-integration-001/confirmation-engine-001')/(case+'-evaluation.json'),result)
 records.append({'case':case,'decision':result['decision'],'reason_codes':[r['code'] for r in result['reasons']],'evaluation_wall_s':result['evaluation_wall_s']})
write_json(Path('artifacts/engine-integration-001/confirmation-engine-001/finite-readback.json'),{'records':records,'new_simulator_executions':0,'scope':'Read-only current evaluator on the original actual stores; original decisions untouched'})
print(records)
